empty.home: Add your first card or account to see what you owe, your available credit, upcoming due dates and spending.
empty.accounts: Add your first card or account to see balances, available credit and due dates.
empty.activity: Transactions from all your accounts will appear here.
empty.reports: Add an account and some transactions to see where your money goes.

accounts.archiveHelp: Archived accounts are hidden from lists and totals but keep their history.
accounts.deleteBody_zero: This account has no transactions. This can't be undone.
accounts.deleteBody_one: This will permanently delete {{count}} transaction, plus any recurring payments and statements for this account. This can't be undone.
accounts.deleteBody_other: This will permanently delete {{count}} transactions, plus any recurring payments and statements for this account. This can't be undone.

accountDetail.noTransactions: No transactions yet. Tap Add to record one.
accountDetail.noPending: No pending holds. Holds are temporary charges, like a gas pump or hotel pre-authorization.
accountDetail.noRecurring: No recurring or pre-authorized payments yet. Add subscriptions, bills and paycheques so they show up before they hit.
accountDetail.noStatements: Statements appear here once each cycle starts.
accountDetail.statementsNeedDay: Add a statement closing day to this card to track statements and due dates.

accountForm.name: Account name
accountForm.institutionHelp: For example TD, RBC or Amex.
accountForm.last4Notice: We never store your full card number, CVV, PIN or expiry date — only the last 4 digits, to help you tell cards apart.
accountForm.amountOwedHelp: What you owe as of the date below, as a positive number.
accountForm.currentBalanceHelp: The account balance as of the date below. Use a minus sign if overdrawn.
accountForm.statementDayHelp: Day of the month the statement closes (1–31). If the month is shorter, it closes on the last day.
accountForm.dueDayOffsetHelp: Days after the statement closes. Canadian cards give at least 21.

errors.nameRequired: Enter a name for this account.
errors.last4: Enter exactly 4 digits, or leave blank.
errors.dueDayOffset: Enter a number of days from 0 to 90.
errors.rate: Enter a rate from 0 to 100, like 19.99.

transactions.deleteLinkedBody: {{payee}}, {{amount}}. The linked transaction in {{name}} will be deleted too. This can't be undone.
transactions.postedBody: Holds often settle for a different amount (a $1 gas hold may post as $54.20). Enter the final amount.
transactions.actionsHint: Swipe or use actions for edit, delete and mark posted.
transactions.voidHelp: Keeps it on record without counting it.

transactionForm.amountHelp: Enter the amount as a positive number; the type sets whether it's money in or out.
transactionForm.otherAccountHelp: Pick one of your accounts to record both sides, e.g. paying your Visa from chequing.
transactionForm.linkedNote: This is linked with {{name}}. Changes to the amount, date, status, notes and category apply to both.

errors.amount: Enter an amount greater than zero, like 54.20.
errors.payeeRequired: Enter who you paid or who paid you.

activity.noResults: No transactions match your search or filters.
activity.limited: Showing the {{count}} most recent matches. Narrow your search to see more.

settings.categoriesHelp: Rename, add or remove spending categories
settings.autoPendingHelp: Confirm each one by marking it posted. Turn off to post them right away.
settings.remindersHelp: Local notifications on this phone only, at 9 a.m.
settings.remindersDenied: Notifications are turned off for CardTrack. Allow them in your phone's Settings app, then try again.
settings.dueDaysBefore: Remind me before a payment is due
settings.dueDaysHelp: You'll also get a reminder on the due date.
settings.testSent: A test reminder will arrive in about 5 seconds. Lock your phone or switch apps to see it.

categoryManager.title: Categories
categoryManager.name: Name
categoryManager.builtInHelp: Built-in categories can be renamed but not deleted.

dashboard.highUtilization: Above 30% — paying down may help your credit score
dashboard.noDueDates: Add a statement closing day to your credit cards to see when payments are due.
dashboard.noRecurring: No recurring or pre-authorized charges in the next 14 days.
dashboard.upVs: Up {{percent}} vs. the same days last month ({{amount}})
dashboard.downVs: Down {{percent}} vs. the same days last month ({{amount}})
dashboard.sameVs: Same as the same days last month
dashboard.noComparison: Nothing spent at this point last month
dashboard.nothingComingUp: Nothing due and no recurring charges in the next two weeks.

rating.high: High · paying down may help your score

dashboard.alertsDue: A payment is due soon. Show what's coming up
dashboard.backToAll: Put the card back with the others

recurring.notFound: This recurring payment no longer exists.
recurring.deleteBody: Transactions it already created are kept. This can't be undone.

recurringForm.payeeHelp: For example Netflix, gym or home insurance.
recurringForm.intervalHelp: 1 = every period. Use 2 for every second month, and so on.
recurringForm.anchorHelp: Any past or future charge date. The others follow from it.
recurringForm.autoCreateHelp: On the charge date, CardTrack adds it for you. Off = just remind me.
recurringForm.remindHelp: 0 = on the day. Turn reminders on in Settings.
recurringForm.isActiveHelp: Turn off to pause without deleting.
recurringForm.noNext: No more charges — this rule has ended.

errors.payeeRequired: Enter who charges you or pays you.
errors.amount: Enter an amount greater than zero, like 16.99.
errors.interval: Enter a whole number from 1 to 52.
errors.remindDays: Enter a number of days from 0 to 30.
errors.endBeforeStart: The end date must be on or after the charge date.

statements.title: Statement
statements.differenceHelp: The statement and your transactions differ. Use Reconcile to find the missing or extra items.
statements.closingHelp: Leave blank to use the balance from your transactions ({{amount}}).
statements.noPayments: No payments linked yet. Payments made after the statement closes and by the due date are linked automatically.
statements.linkHelp: Other payments you can link to this statement:
statements.reconcileHelp: Tick each transaction that appears on your paper or PDF statement.
statements.reconcileNeedsBalance: Enter the closing balance from your statement first.
statements.reconcileDifference: Difference {{amount}} — keep ticking, or look for a missing transaction.

errors.amount: Enter an amount like 1234.56, or leave blank.

reminders.testBody: This is what a payment reminder looks like.

import.title: Import CSV
import.open: Import transactions from a CSV file
import.intro: Download a CSV of your transactions from your bank's website, save it to Files, then pick it here. Nothing is uploaded — the file is read on this phone.
import.unreadable: That file couldn't be read as CSV.
import.undoBody_zero: Its transactions were already deleted. This removes the import record.
import.undoBody_one: This deletes the {{count}} transaction it added, including any edits you made to it.
import.undoBody_other: This deletes the {{count}} transactions it added, including any edits you made to them.
import.stepMapHelp: Check the preview: dates, payees and amounts should look right. Money out should be negative.
import.invertSign: Flip the sign of every amount
import.invertSignHelp: Turn on if purchases show as positive (common in credit card files).
import.problemCount_one: {{count}} line can't be read and will be skipped (headers, totals or blank lines are normal).
import.problemCount_other: {{count}} lines can't be read and will be skipped (headers, totals or blank lines are normal).
import.duplicatesHelp: Duplicates (same date, amount and description) are skipped.
import.nothingNew: Everything in this file is already in this account.
import.doneHelp: The column matching was saved for {{institution}}, so next time it's set up for you.

reports.spentHelp: Purchases, fees and interest, minus refunds. Payments and transfers between your accounts don't count.
reports.subtitle: Your money, answered
reports.standAhead: You have {{amount}} more than you owe.
reports.standBehind: You owe {{amount}} more than you have.
reports.safeShortfall: Short by {{amount}} — move money or plan payments before they're due.
reports.spendNoCompare: {{amount}} so far, with nothing to compare against yet.
reports.trendNoAverage: Your monthly average appears after your first full month.
reports.aboveAverage: {{month}} is {{percent}} above your average so far.
reports.withinAverage: {{month}} is within your average so far.

exportCsv.title: Export
exportCsv.unavailable: Sharing files isn't available on this device.

backup.title: Back up
backup.backUpHelp: Saves everything in one file you can keep in Files or iCloud Drive. The file isn't encrypted — keep it somewhere private.
backup.restoreHelp: Replaces everything in the app with the contents of a backup file.
backup.confirmBody: This backup is from {{date}} with {{accounts}} accounts and {{transactions}} transactions. Everything currently in CardTrack will be replaced. This can't be undone.

problems.notBackup: That file isn't a CardTrack backup.
problems.newerVersion: That backup was made by a newer version of CardTrack. Update the app, then try again.
problems.damaged: That backup is damaged, so nothing was changed.

stepper.amountHint: Just the number. You'll say what it was next.

accountHint.out: Where the money came out of.

stepper.payeeHintLinked: Optional. We'll describe it from the two accounts if you skip this.
stepper.detailsHint: Check it over, add a category, then save.

typeHints.payment: Paid down a card or loan

typeHints.credit: A card you pay off each month
typeHints.prepaid: A card you load in advance

accountStepper.nameHint: A name you'll recognize, like "TD Visa" or "Joint chequing".
accountStepper.lookHint: It's how you'll spot this card at a glance.
accountStepper.owedTitle: How much do you owe on it?
accountStepper.creditHint: All optional. Add a closing day to see when payments are due.
accountStepper.reviewHint: Check it over, then add it.
accountStepper.loanHint: Optional. Add the monthly payment as a recurring payment so it shows in Coming up and gets reminders.

recurringStepper.reviewHint: Choose reminders and a category, then save.

pro.title: CardTrack Pro
pro.unlocked: Pro is unlocked. Thanks for supporting CardTrack.
pro.cardArtHelp: Use any picture as a card's background. Pictures stay on this device.
pro.comingSoon: Purchases open with the App Store and Google Play release.
pro.payoffHelp: See your debt-free date and what paying a little extra saves.

cardArt.title: Card appearance
cardArt.settingsHelp: Use your own pictures as card backgrounds (Pro).
cardArt.notice: Use artwork or a photo you like, not a photo of your real card. A real card shows its full number, which CardTrack never keeps. Pictures stay on this device and aren't included in backups.
cardArt.proBody: Unlock CardTrack Pro to give your cards your own pictures.

payoff.title: Debt payoff
payoff.proTitle: Plan your way out of debt
payoff.proBody: See the month you'll be debt-free, how much interest it costs, and how much paying a little extra saves. Part of CardTrack Pro.
payoff.noDebts: Nothing owed on your cards, lines of credit or loans. Nicely done.
payoff.notOnTrackHelp: At this amount you won't get out of debt: the payments don't keep up with the interest. Raise the monthly amount below.
payoff.avalancheHint: Extra money goes to the debt with the highest rate.
payoff.snowballHint: Extra money goes to the smallest debt, so whole debts disappear sooner.
payoff.stuck: The minimum doesn't cover this debt's interest.
payoff.assumptions: An estimate: assumes no new spending, rates that stay the same, and interest charged monthly.
payoff.noRateNote: Debts with no interest rate are treated as 0%; add the rate on the account for a truer plan.
payoff.minimumHelp: The minimum payment on your latest statement, or your loan's monthly payment.
payoff.minimumInvalid: Enter an amount greater than zero.
payoff.savesShort_one: Paying this much saves {{interest}} in interest and gets you out {{count}} month sooner.
payoff.savesShort_other: Paying this much saves {{interest}} in interest and gets you out {{count}} months sooner.
payoff.monthlyTitle: How much can you put toward debt each month?
payoff.breakdownMinimumsOnly: That's just the minimum payments ({{minimums}}). Tap + to see what a little more does.
payoff.belowMinimums: That's less than your minimum payments ({{amount}}).
payoff.estimatedCallout_one: 1 minimum payment is our estimate. Tap that debt below to enter the one on your statement.
payoff.estimatedCallout_other: {{count}} minimum payments are our estimates. Tap a debt below to enter the one on your statement.
payoff.orderSame: Either order costs about the same here.
payoff.rollsTo: Its payment moves to {{name}}: {{amount}} a month now goes there.
payoff.trackHelp: Save this plan as your starting point. Each time you come back, we'll compare what you really owe with where the plan expects you to be.
payoff.progressOnTrackHelp: You owe about what the plan expected by today.
payoff.progressAheadHelp: You've paid down more than planned. Nicely done.
payoff.progressBehindHelp: New spending on these debts or a smaller payment can do this. Paying {{amount}} extra catches you up.
payoff.paidOffShare: {{percent}} paid off of the {{start}} you started with.
payoff.trackingChanged: Tracking since {{date}} at {{amount}} a month. You've changed the amount since; progress still compares with the plan you started. Start over to track the new one.
payoff.cardTeaser: See the month you'll be debt-free and what paying a little extra saves.
payoff.cardNotOnTrack: At this amount the payments don't keep up with the interest.

installments.emptyBody: Paying something off in monthly parts on this card, like a phone or laptop over 12 months? Add it here to see how many payments are left and when it ends.
installments.notFound: This installment plan no longer exists.
installments.deleteBody: The plan is removed. Transactions you've recorded on the card stay as they are.

installmentForm.summaryEmpty: Enter the amount and number of months to see the monthly payment.
installmentForm.descriptionHelp: For example: iPhone, sofa, flight to Manila.
installmentForm.monthlyAuto: Leave blank to split evenly: {{amount}} a month.
installmentForm.monthlyHelp: The amount on your statement each month.
installmentForm.feeHelp: Some plans add a fixed fee each month instead of interest.
installmentForm.firstPaymentHelp: Already paying it? Pick the date of the first payment; we'll count the ones made since.

errors.descriptionRequired: Say what the plan is for.
errors.amount: Enter an amount greater than zero, like 1200.
errors.months: Enter a number of months from 1 to 120.
errors.tooSmall: At this amount the plan never pays off the total.
